purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance receipt (レセプト) DPC file creation – inpatient admission/discharge processing for the JMA ORCA medical billing system
purpose.summary: ORCRDPC10 creates DPC (Diagnosis Procedure Combination) E/F files for the ORCA medical receipt subsystem. It reads and writes multiple indexed ISAM files (RECE62, RECE641, RECE65, RECE68, RECE69, RECE900) representing receipt detail, admission/discharge history, and sequence numbers, computing procedure points and billing flags for inpatient claims. The program has an extensive revision history spanning 2007–2017 covering Japanese fiscal-year regulatory changes.

notable_features: Multiple INDEXED ORGANIZATION files with DYNAMIC access
470 PERFORM statements indicating complex structured logic
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
No COMP-3 (unusual for billing system – points stored as PIC 9)
CPTEMPFL.INC copybook used repeatedly with REPLACING for file-name parameterisation
verdict.notes: Source is encoded in EUC-JP but decoded as latin-1, making all Japanese comments appear as garbled bytes. File is 7657 lines and clearly production ORCA medical billing code. Truncated to first 16000 chars for analysis but structure and purpose are unambiguous from the visible portion.
